modalLead: A fix on top of v2026.09.09: opening a bookmark from Health no longer claims its category had been deleted.

items.text: Opening a bookmark from Health no longer claims its category was deleted. The jump was following the link before the grid had been drawn at all, so it searched an empty page and reported a category that was sitting in plain sight. It now runs once the grid is up, and waits if it is still rendering.
